nodes.description: mapping(address => uint256) public balance recording each investor's principal
mapping(address => uint256) public atBlock recording block number of last transaction
address public house, the casino owner that receives tips
constructor() public that sets house = msg.sender
function () external payable fallback that accrues balance and runs the 50% lottery payout
msg.sender used as investor key, transfer recipient and deployer of house
block.timestamp used inside blockhash() for pseudo-random toss
weak randomness: uint8(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(blockhash(block.timestamp), block.difficulty, block.coinbase))) % 2, miner/validator manipulable
external call msg.sender.transfer(profit * 2) executed before state settlement, reentrancy vector
external call house.transfer(winning * 5 / 100) to the privileged house address
arithmetic: balance[msg.sender] += msg.value executed after the external transfer, unchecked increment
uint256 profit, accrued 5% per day interest for the caller
uint8 toss, lottery coin flip derived from weak randomness
uint256 winning, doubled profit used to compute the house tip

edges.reason: constructor assigns house from the deployer address
msg.sender of the deployment transaction becomes house
msg.sender sends a transaction that invokes the fallback entry point
balance[msg.sender] is read to compute profit
atBlock[msg.sender] is read to compute elapsed blocks for profit
msg.sender indexes the balance and atBlock mappings inside the profit arithmetic
block.timestamp feeds blockhash() used for the pseudo-random toss, making the outcome timestamp/miner dependent
the randomness result modulo 2 produces the toss local variable
toss == 0 branch drives execution into the player payout transfer
the profit arithmetic unsafe operation yields the profit local variable
profit is multiplied by two and passed to msg.sender.transfer
winning local variable is computed as profit * 2
winning is divided by 100 and used as the 5% house tip
msg.sender is the recipient of the external transfer, enabling a reentrant fallback call
house tip transfer executes immediately after the player transfer
contract state (balance mapping) is updated only after the external transfer to msg.sender, the classic reentrancy ordering
msg.sender indexes the balance mapping for the post-transfer increment

normalization_plan.reason: local variable profit is produced solely by the profit arithmetic unsafe_operation, so merge it into that core node
local variable toss is the modulo-2 result of the weak randomness unsafe_operation and has no independent semantics
local variable winning exists only to size the house tip accompanying the player transfer, so merge it into the transfer unsafe_operation
